subject: dym-f
title: (R)DYM.F.------PRI.INFO.
description: First of two diagrams closing R(AS)CM(I)-33, the section on alternative recording. The prose above names the structural stake: the implication of musicians-as-recording-companies (Jazz Composer's Orchestra, Strata East) is 'directly related to the realness of decentralization — that being, the possibility of breaking the dominance that certain sectors of the planet now enjoy over the composite planet with respect to both information exposure as well as economics.' The crossing diagrams what decentralization actually crosses: (R)DYM-F (the *reality* of dynamic functionalism) is crossed with PRI-INFO (principle information — the established exposure-narrative that recording companies built around the music). DYM-F sits on the left with the subject-arrow; BIA (bi-aitional) hangs from the main line, with SOC-RT (social reality) branching from it. ALT-D (alternative definitions) rises at the top center of the diagram as the bridging hub. PRI-INFO sits at lower-center as partner-center. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) branches from ALT-D; AFI-1 (affinity insight—first degree) and POST (postulation) hang from VT-DY. INFO-DY (information dynamics) and EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) branch from POST, and RE-ST (restructuralism) from INFO-DY.
